notes: Names/boundaries were assigned by hand after inspecting cluster top-terms and example messages. Clusters were consolidated (e.g. the 3 delivery-related clusters -> DELIVERY_STATUS + DELIVERY_QUALITY) and 2 were rejected as not distinct intents ('Yes'/short acknowledgements is a dialogue-act, not an intent; folded into whichever intent the surrounding context implies).

intents.name: Order / Delivery Status Inquiry
intents.description: Customer wants to know where an order or package is, or is reporting a delay.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Message asks for tracking/ETA, or states an order/package has not arrived by expected date.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Package arrived but is damaged/wrong item (-> DELIVERY_QUALITY_ISSUE). Asking for a refund because of delay (-> REFUND_RETURN) unless status is the primary ask.
representative_examples: Where is my order? [URL]
My order is due to arrive on Friday
hey amazon, my echo dot is taking 4 days to be delivered even though I am in Mumbai.

intents.name: Delivery / Package Quality Problem
intents.description: Package delivered but damaged, wrong item, delivered to wrong address, or marked delivered but not received.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Explicit statement of a completed-but-flawed delivery: damage, wrong item, wrong recipient, false 'delivered' status.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Order still in transit and simply late (-> ORDER_STATUS).
representative_examples: it'd be nice if the book I waited 4 months for wasn't damaged inside of an undented box.
Package yet to be received. The delivery boy must've signed himself or delivered to someone else.
I don't have an amazon account. The parcel has been delivered to the wrong address.

intents.name: Refund / Return / Replacement Request
intents.description: Customer explicitly wants money back, a replacement item, or is initiating/complaining about a return.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Contains explicit ask for refund/return/replacement/compensation, or complains a refund wasn't given.
intents.exclusion_criteria: General dissatisfaction with no explicit refund/return ask (-> COMPLAINT_SERVICE_QUALITY).
representative_examples: I want refund amount, amazon seller was lying.
Do not make us helpless and kindly refund my amount.
req a replace for one of my purchase it was scheduled for today

intents.name: Account Access / Login / Verification
intents.description: Problems logging in, 2FA/verification codes not arriving, account locked/blocked.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions login, password, verification code, 2-step, account being blocked/locked.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Billing/payment method issues without a login component (-> BILLING_PAYMENT).
representative_examples: Im not receiving 2step code by text or call in my smartphone can't log in into my account
It's not allowing me to update it to register my new amazon account.
germany blocked my account for CC check several months ago

intents.name: Billing / Payment / Charges
intents.description: Disputes or questions about charges, payment methods, gift cards, being charged incorrectly.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Mentions being charged, card declined, payment method, gift card balance/redemption.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Refund of a specific order (-> REFUND_RETURN) unless the core issue is the payment mechanism itself.
representative_examples: No i've already done that and you have taken more money out of my bank!
no luck on receiving the code by text or call, will I loose my account

intents.name: Prime Membership
intents.description: Questions or complaints specifically about Prime membership, benefits, or cancellation.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Explicit mention of 'Prime' membership status, benefits, shipping tier, or cancellation.
intents.exclusion_criteria: General shipping speed complaint with no Prime framing (-> ORDER_STATUS).
representative_examples: Two fake items in one day. Time to cancel my Amazon Prime membership.
what is the use of Prime Membership if I am not getting my parcel on time.
So much of the programming has changed on Prime.

intents.name: Digital Content / Device Support
intents.description: Issues with Kindle, Echo/Alexa, Fire TV, Amazon Music/Prime Video apps or hardware.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Names a specific Amazon device or digital service and describes a functional problem.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Order/delivery issue for a device purchase, not a functional/software problem (-> ORDER_STATUS).
representative_examples: My Kindle not working properly is breaking my heart!
Trying to get a friend's playlist on my Amazon music app but it keeps giving me the following message
please teach Alexa slang. I've been trying to play a song for 30 minutes.

intents.name: General Service Quality Complaint
intents.description: Complaint about customer service experience/quality itself (rudeness, unhelpfulness, being ignored), without a specific transactional ask.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Primary content is evaluative language about service quality ('worst customer service', 'no one helped me') without a concrete order/refund/account ask as the main point.
intents.exclusion_criteria: If a concrete ask (refund, order status) is present, classify by that ask instead.
representative_examples: I waited 15 days, sent 10 emails, was assured the case was escalated, today's response WE CANNOT HELP.
Hahaha. Reported multiple times...even spoke to ur so called customer service.. no help...
s/o to Amer at customer service for being helpful and understanding

intents.name: Pre-purchase / Product Information Question
intents.description: Customer asking a question about a product, listing, or policy before or independent of a transaction problem.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Question-form message about product availability, specs, or policy with no indication of an existing order problem.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Question about an existing order's status (-> ORDER_STATUS).
representative_examples: kann man Prime auch mit einem Gutschein bezahlen?
Does your app have a feedback option "product not delivered"?

intents.name: Acknowledgement / Follow-up in Existing Thread
intents.description: Short reply that only makes sense with prior context: confirmations, 'yes', 'details sent', thanks with no new content.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Message is a short dialogue-act continuing a prior thread (confirmation, thanks, 'done') rather than introducing new content.
intents.exclusion_criteria: If the short message introduces a new concrete issue, classify by that issue instead.
representative_examples: Details sent. Please check.
Yes shipped yesterday
Yes, I've sent an email through your link.

intents.name: Abusive / Legal Threat / Explicit Escalation Demand
intents.description: Message contains hostility/profanity directed at the brand, legal/regulatory threats, or explicit demand to speak to a manager/corporate.
intents.inclusion_criteria: Profanity/hostility directed at brand or staff, legal threat, or explicit 'let me speak to a manager/corporate' demand.
intents.exclusion_criteria: Frustration expressed without hostility or explicit escalation demand (-> COMPLAINT_SERVICE_QUALITY).
representative_examples: your reps dont even check any back data they just rape the customers.
Want to speak to someone at corp to address these issues.

intents.name: Other / Unclear
intents.description: Message is off-topic (promotional, unrelated commentary), too ambiguous to classify, or does not fit any intent above.
intents.inclusion_criteria: No clear support ask; spam-like; ambiguous fragment; positive unsolicited mention with no request.
representative_examples: Anna Inspired in idea lab at school to be package being shipped to Narnia! "Amazon can go anywhere" according to Anna.
Super happy to have received my new toy #EchoShow #BlackFriday.
